title: Ruuhu Leelɗo Hakkunde Annabaaɓe
intro: Daande noddaande peewal ina ɓuuɓtoo e nder aayaaji Qur’aana tedduɗo oo. Ndee ɗoo yonta barkinaaɗo rokkaama annabaagal e binndol Alla e nder yonta mo ardaade ina haani no feewi e nder Ɓiɓɓe Isra’iila. Oo neɗɗo haaliino e leñol maɓɓe, ina ñaagii ɓe nde ɓe ciftortoo Joomiraawo maɓɓe. E nder muñal e dewal, ɓe ngonti fitirla kaa, daartol mum ina yayna kelle binndi ceniiɗi. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ooɗoo neɗɗo teskinɗo mo innde mum teddiniraa e nder Quraan e Linjiila fof?
clues: Mi teddinaama e annabaagal e deftere asamaan e sahaa haaju leñol am.
Yumma am jibinii kam e mbaadi kaawniindi, ko e yamiroore Alla tan.
Mi yeewtidi e leñol am, mbiy-mi ‘Eeh ɓiɓɓe Isra’iila! Miin ko mi nelaaɗo Alla feewde e maa, tabitinoowo ko adii mi koo.”
Mi arii e maandeeji laaɓtuɗi ummoraade e joom maa, miɗo addana mi kabaaru belɗo annabi gooto biyeteeɗo Ahmadu.
Yumma am ko debbo peewɗo, dariiɗo mi e gollal Alla gila e cukaagu am.
Alla jannginii kam Quraana, waɗi mi yurmeende e gollal e yumma am, mi wonaa mawnikinaare, mi wonaa ɗooftotooɗo.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Annabi Muhammadu صلى الله عليه وسلم

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Waɗii ƴettude haa asamaan e ɓanndu
outcome.answer: Waɗii ƴettude haa asamaan e ɓanndu

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
